hero.title: Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Main Restaurant)
hero.body: Reserve your table at Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Main Restaurant), and immerse yourself in authentic Balinese cuisine, live cultural performances, and hands-on cooking and cocktail classes.

experiences.intro1: From dining to dancing to hands-on classes, every experience at Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Main Restaurant) takes place at this one location.
experiences.intro2: Join us Thursday evenings for our complimentary Balinese Dance Performance, held exclusively here at the Main Restaurant.

items.title: Balinese Cooking Class
items.desc: Learn traditional recipes hands-on with our local chefs, from spice garden to table.

items.title: Balinese Dance Dinner
items.desc: A complimentary traditional dance performance every Thursday evening, exclusively here.

items.title: Balinese Bar Class
items.desc: Step behind the bar and craft your own signature cocktail with authentic Balinese Arak.

gallery.body: Showcase beautifully captured moments from birthdays, family gatherings, corporate dinners, wedding receptions, and private events hosted at Raja Bali.

descParts.text: Raja Bali Nusa Dua (Main Restaurant) is located in Nusa Dua, close to Bali's leading luxury resorts, cultural attractions, shopping destinations, and pristine beaches. Whether you're joining our
, or simply dining with family and friends, every experience takes place at this convenient location.
